new.s: What are the main aims of the optional T+0 (same-day) settlement introduced by SEBI?
o: Higher brokerage income for stock exchanges
Better liquidity and lower settlement and counterparty risk
new.x: T+0 is optional and runs alongside T+1; it aims at better liquidity, lower settlement and counterparty risk and more efficiency.
new.angle: U0535 #3 Recent reforms -> T+0 settlement aims

new.s: Which body hears appeals against the orders of SEBI and stock exchanges?
new.x: The Securities Appellate Tribunal (1995, SEBI Act Section 15K) hears appeals against SEBI and stock exchanges; further appeal lies to the Supreme Court.

new.s: Why did SEBI lower the ticket (face value) size of corporate bonds?
o: To keep retail investors out of the bond market
To raise the cost of bond issues
To shift corporate bonds to RBI regulation
To draw retail investors into the bond market
new.x: A smaller face value lets small (retail) investors buy corporate bonds.
new.angle: U0535 N1 Debt market -> bond ticket size

new.s: Who frames the regulations for the issue and listing of municipal bonds in India?
o: Ministry of Housing and Urban Affairs
new.x: Municipal debt securities are issued and listed under SEBI regulations.
new.angle: U0535 N1 Debt market -> municipal bond regulations

new.s:
Arrange the following in chronological order:
1. Securities Appellate Tribunal set up
2. NSE recognised
3. SEBI gets statutory status
4. Forward Markets Commission merged into SEBI
Select the correct answer using the code given below.
new.x: SEBI became statutory in 1992, NSE was recognised in April 1993, SAT came in 1995 and FMC merged into SEBI in 2015.

new.s: What does the secondary market deal in?
new.x: The secondary market is for trading existing securities; new issues come in the primary market.
new.angle: U0535 #1 Capital market regulator -> market terms

new.s: Who replaced Prashant Kumar as the CEO of Yes Bank in April 2026?
new.x: Prashant Kumar led Yes Bank from March 2020 after the SBI-led rescue; Vinay Tonse replaced him on 6 April 2026.

new.s: What was the gross NPA ratio of Indian banks in September 2025?
new.x: Banks' GNPA was 2.2% and NNPA 0.5% in September 2025.
new.angle: U0536 #8 Early warning -> bank health data

new.s: Which risk did the RBI's Financial Stability Report of June 2026 flag?
new.x: The half-yearly FSR of June 2026 flagged unsecured lending by fintechs as a risk.

new.s: Which of the following banks is NOT a Domestic Systemically Important Bank (D-SIB) named by the RBI?
new.x: The RBI's D-SIBs are SBI, ICICI Bank and HDFC Bank; Axis Bank is not on the list.

new.s: Which type of inflation arises when aggregate demand exceeds aggregate supply at the full-employment level of output?
new.x: When demand runs above full-employment output (an inflationary gap), prices are pulled up: demand-pull inflation.
new.angle: U0537 PYQ y09debab9579 inflationary gap angle

new.s: Which type of inflation is described as 'too much money chasing too few goods'?
new.x: Demand-pull inflation comes from excess demand: too much money chasing too few goods.

new.s:
Arrange the following types of inflation in ascending order of their speed:
1. Galloping inflation
2. Creeping inflation
3. Hyperinflation
4. Walking inflation
Select the correct answer using the code given below.
new.x: Creeping (below 3%) is slowest, then walking (3-10%), then galloping, and hyperinflation is the most severe.

new.s: At what price per kg was Bharat Chana Dal sold from July 2023?
new.x: Bharat Chana Dal was sold at ₹60 a kg from July 2023 through NAFED, NCCF and Kendriya Bhandar.

new.s: Which pulse was later added to the Bharat Dal initiative after chana dal?
new.x: Bharat Dal began with chana dal and was later extended to moong dal.
new.angle: U0537 PYQ yfc228c7f253 Bharat brand items angle

new.s:

List-I (Index) - List-II (Current base year)
A. CPI-Combined - 1. 2016

new.x: CPI-Combined is on base 2024, CPI-IW on 2016, CPI-AL on 2019 and WPI on 2011-12.

new.angle: U0537 #12 Headline measure -> inflation targeting law

new.x: Section 45ZA deals with target-setting; 45ZB is the six-member MPC and 45ZN the report on a breach.
new.angle: U0537 #12 Inflation target -> RBI Act section

new.s: Which base year of the WPI did the Abhijit Sen working group recommend?

new.angle: U0537 #8 Committees on price indices -> Abhijit Sen

new.s: How many items does the new CPI series (base 2024) cover?

new.s: Which tax is levied as a fixed amount per unit of weight or quantity of a commodity?
new.x: A specific tax is a fixed amount per unit; an ad valorem tax is a percentage of value.
new.angle: U0538 PYQ yec905c561a0 ad valorem vs specific angle

new.s: How is an ad valorem tax levied on a commodity?
o: As a fixed amount per unit of quantity
As an extra charge on the tax payable
As a percentage of the value of the commodity
As a payment for a specific service
new.x: Ad valorem means 'according to value': the tax is a percentage of the commodity's value.
new.angle: U0538 PYQ yec905c561a0 / y5d13fe15596 ad valorem angle

new.s: If the demand for a commodity is perfectly inelastic, who bears the full burden of an indirect tax imposed on it?
new.x: With zero elasticity buyers do not cut purchases, so the price rises by the full tax and the incidence falls on the consumer.
new.angle: U0538 PYQ y5d13fe15596 tax incidence and elasticity angle

new.s: Who headed the Task Forces of 2002 that gave reports on both direct and indirect taxes?

new.angle: U0538 #7 Tax reform committees -> Kelkar (PYQ ye8c24f77b76 angle)

new.s: Which of the following is NOT a feature of Value Added Tax (VAT)?
o: It taxes value added at all stages between production and final sale
It is self-enforcing through the invoice-credit trail
new.x: VAT is non-cascading, multi-stage and self-enforcing, and it improves revenue buoyancy rather than reducing it.
new.angle: U0538 PYQ ycf65e9f40d1 VAT concept angle

new.s: Why is VAT called a self-enforcing tax?
o: It is collected only by the Centre
Its invoice-credit trail makes each buyer check the seller's tax
It is levied only at the final stage of sale
Its rates are fixed by the Finance Commission
new.x: A buyer gets credit only for tax shown on the seller's invoice, so each stage checks the earlier one.

new.s: Which of the following indirect taxes was subsumed in GST from 1 July 2017?
new.x: Service tax was subsumed in GST; corporation tax and STT are direct taxes and basic customs duty stays outside GST.
new.angle: U0538 PYQ y14f20defa41 GST replaced indirect taxes angle

new.s:
Assertion (A): A simpler tax system raises productivity in the economy.
Reason (R): A simpler tax system removes deadweight costs and distortions in the allocation of resources.
Select the correct answer using the code given below.
o: Both A and R are true and R is the correct explanation of A
Both A and R are true, but R is not the correct explanation of A
A is true, but R is false
A is false, but R is true
new.x: Simplification removes deadweight costs and allocation distortions, and that is why productivity rises; R explains A.
new.angle: U0538 #16 Effects of tax changes -> simplification and productivity

new.s: What was the Centre's gross tax revenue as a percentage of GDP in 2019-20, as per the Economic Survey 2021-22?
new.x: The Centre's gross tax revenue was 9.9% of GDP in 2019-20; it rose to about 11.5% after the pandemic.

new.s: Under which Article of the Constitution can a State levy a tax on professions, trades and employments?
new.x: Article 276 lets States levy profession tax, with a ceiling of ₹2,500 a year.
new.angle: U0538 #8 Constitutional basis -> profession tax Article

new.s: Under which Act is customs duty levied on imports and exports in India?
new.x: Customs duty on imports and exports is levied under the Customs Act, 1962.

new.s: In which year was the Voluntary Disclosure of Income Scheme (VDIS) launched?
new.x: VDIS 1997 allowed voluntary disclosure of black income; IDS and PMGKY followed in 2016.

new.s: What is 'e-Sahyog' of the Income Tax Department?
o: An online check of mismatches in returns for compliance
A disclosure scheme for foreign assets
new.x: e-Sahyog lets taxpayers settle mismatches online without a physical visit.

new.s: What does the Annual Information Statement (AIS) of the Income Tax Department show?
o: Only the PAN details of a taxpayer
All reported financial transactions of a taxpayer
new.x: AIS shows all reported transactions of a taxpayer and is used to pre-fill returns (2021).

new.s: In which Budget was the Minimum Alternate Tax (MAT) first introduced under Section 115J?
new.x: MAT came in Budget 1987-88 (Section 115J), was withdrawn in 1990 and restarted in Budget 1996-97.
new.angle: U0539 #12 Special corporate levies -> MAT introduction

new.s: Under which Section of the Income-tax Act is the rebate given that makes income up to ₹12 lakh tax-free under the new regime?

new.angle: U0539 #1 Income tax regimes -> Section 87A rebate

new.s: What was the 'one-by-six' scheme in income tax?
o: Compulsory return filing by persons showing any one of six signs of lifestyle
A tax rate of one-sixth of income
A rebate for six kinds of savings
Payment of advance tax in six instalments
new.x: Under the one-by-six scheme a person meeting any one of six lifestyle criteria had to file a return; telephone was dropped in Budget 2002-03.

new.s: What is the rate of long-term capital gains (LTCG) tax in India as of August 2026?
new.x: LTCG is taxed at 12.5%; an asset held up to 24 months is generally short-term.

new.s: Which Section of the CGST Act requires that the benefit of a GST rate cut or input tax credit be passed on to consumers?

new.s: For how many years did the GST (Compensation to States) Act, 2017 provide compensation to States?
new.x: The Act gave 5 years of compensation, assuming 14% annual growth over the 2015-16 base; it ended in June 2022.

new.s: Who was the first chairperson of the GST Council?
new.x: The Union Finance Minister chairs the Council; Arun Jaitley was its first chair.

new.s: Which Constitution Amendment Bill on GST, introduced in March 2011, lapsed?
new.x: The 115th Amendment Bill (2011) lapsed; the 122nd Bill (2014) became the 101st Amendment Act, 2016.

new.s: From which date did the GST 2.0 rate rationalisation come into effect?
new.x: The 56th Council meeting (3-4 September 2025) approved GST 2.0, effective 22 September 2025.

new.s:
Arrange the following events relating to GST in chronological order:
1. 101st Amendment Act gets Presidential assent
2. 122nd Amendment Bill is tabled
3. GST is rolled out across India
4. GST 2.0 comes into effect
Select the correct answer using the code given below.
new.x: The 122nd Bill came in December 2014, assent to the 101st Act in September 2016, rollout on 1 July 2017 and GST 2.0 in September 2025.

new.s: Before GST, under which entry of the State List was VAT levied?
new.x: VAT was a State subject under Entry 54 of the State List.

new.s: What are the turnover limit and tax rate for service providers under the GST composition scheme?
new.x: Service providers with turnover up to ₹50 lakh pay 6%; for goods the limit is ₹1.5 crore at 1%; no ITC is allowed.
